item.title: Mandarin Oriental interiors move the North Flagler comparison beyond skyline renderings
item.description: Recent reporting highlighted the first interior renderings for Mandarin Oriental Residences, West Palm Beach, giving buyers more to compare than tower massing and brand name alone.

item.title: NORA House keeps Downtown's ownership story in the local news cycle
item.description: Recent local coverage continues to frame NORA House as the first for-sale residential anchor inside the growing NORA district, shifting the downtown discussion from restaurants only to actual ownership inventory.

item.title: Shorecrest financing pushes the North Flagler cluster toward construction
item.description: Related Ross announced a $157 million construction loan for Shorecrest, adding momentum to the North Flagler waterfront cluster.

item.title: Banyan Tree locks in 88 branded residences at 400 Hibiscus
item.description: Banyan Group announced the launch of Banyan Tree Residences West Palm Beach, adding another branded-residence option to the downtown buyer map.

item.title: NORA House pairs its district launch with a deeper public plan stack
item.description: NORA House gives buyers a clearer ownership option inside the fast-changing NORA district rather than only nearby rental, hotel, retail, and restaurant activity.
